rapport_notes: Jack is friendly, conversational, and builds natural rapport; uses customer's name, asks clarifying questions warmly, and maintains an easy tone throughout.
process_discipline_notes: Jack asks the close-framing line 'If you guys do decide to move forward' but does not follow it with genuine silence—he immediately launches into feature delivery (no deposits, damage coverage) without pause for customer reflection.

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Absent. Jack jumps directly into 'First thing I saw you put help with packing' without framing the call or trading the ask for a benefit.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Absent. Jack never asks 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move' or equivalent. Probing starts immediately.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A—no customer concerns were raised because the agenda question was never asked.
evidence_quotes.sheet1_careful_with: Jack: 'Any special consideration items, anything that's like super fragile, extra delicate family air. Looms?' Later delivers damage coverage: 'we include up to 2000 dollars for every single move and that's value based coverage.'
evidence_quotes.sheet2_whos_coming: Not covered. No mention of Meet Your Mover, who specifically will show up, or crew lead name/continuity.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: Not covered anywhere in the call.
evidence_quotes.communication: Not covered. No mention of day-before call, named crew lead updates, or communication protocol.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor_and_personalize: Jack: 'I would probably have about five to six hours set aside for the packing day' and 'I have about five to six hours set aside that would give us about three hours to get everything loaded and then two to three hours to get to drive and, and get everything unloaded.' He personalizes to 'townhomes' and the three-story layout with multiple delicate items.
evidence_quotes.estimate_is_a_window: Jack: 'but again with us, it is just based on time' and 'but if it's you know, super minimal and we're able to pack the kitchen in two hours and the rest of two hours. Then four hours is how much you would pay for.'
evidence_quotes.self_prep_tip: Jack: 'if there's anything you are comfortable with us, you know, wrapping or prepping then that'll just help us make the move day, go even faster.'
evidence_quotes.rate_lock: Jack: 'If you ever, just want to pick a date and hold it there's no payments upfront so if ever have a date and we'll lock it in, we can hold it for you.'
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Absent. Jack says 'I hope you enjoy the rest of your Sunday' and 'we'd love to help you out' but does not ask 'Would you like our help with your move?' or equivalent direct close.

top_strength: Jack built strong rapport and gathered detailed logistics information efficiently, personalizing his estimate to the three-story townhome layout and customer's specific items (treadmill, heavy dining table, minimal decor) in a natural, conversational manner.
coaching_note: Stop and ask 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?' before any logistics probing—this is the single highest-priority line in the script and unlocks follow-up depth; also deliver a hard close ask ('Would you like our help with your move?') rather than an assumed close.
